{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft pointed collar, hip length, ivory (#F3EDE0), matte crepe

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full ankle length, charcoal grey (#3C4048), fine wool blend

Single-breasted blazer, tailored fit, hip length, camel-and-oat herringbone (#B79C77), textured wool

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, burgundy (#6B2A33), smooth leather

Structured tote bag, medium size, top handles, cognac (#9A5B34), grained leather

Slim belt, simple gold-tone buckle, burgundy (#6B2A33), smooth leather

Small hoop earrings, brushed gold (#C9A24D), metal

This outfit sits right in the neat business-casual band: a blouse with tailored trousers and a textured blazer, finished with loafers. The ivory blouse and charcoal trousers form a calm base, while the herringbone blazer adds warmth and depth that suit autumn. The burgundy loafers and belt tie in with the cognac bag for a coordinated, grown-up palette. The blazer works as the layer for cooler mornings and comes off easily in a warm office, and every piece is comfortable enough for a full workday."}
